g.text: 📊 Studio Dashboard
Recordings, drafts & narration pipelines in one clean workspace

Precision window, area select, mic audio and webcam toggles
⚡ Universal AI Model Hub
Bring Your Own Key: Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Claude with failover

Screen, mic voiceover, webcam bubble, and dynamic keynote intro/outro
🎙 AI Tutorial Studio
Step-by-step narration powered by embedded Kokoro + Resona neural TTS
🎯 Cursor Polish & Spring Physics
Smoothed paths, click shockwaves, bounce effects, and 4.0x size scale
🖼 Camera & Canvas Styling
16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 aspect ratios, outer canvas padding and rounded corners
📹 Dynamic Webcam Bubble
Zoom-reactive facecam bubble in circle or pill layout that never hides UI
💬 Animated Captions & Subtitles
Fade, Slide, Bounce, and Pop word-level subtitles with token styles
⚙ Production Export Studio
Crisp 4K/1080p, 60fps rendering, hardware NVENC encoding, and MP4/WebM
Tutora AI Studio - Native Desktop App
